statements.markdown: **Lemma B.6.** Let $Z$ be a region on which $|(r,z)|$ exceeds a radius that depends on the direction, with a number $\Lambda_0$ as in (B.30), and let $\iota$ belong to its set of harmonics. Then (B.31) holds. Let now $Z$ be a region that reaches infinity, given for $\iota$, for which (B.31) holds. If the weights are admissible and the conditions on $Z$ hold, then the negative part of $\mathcal I_\iota^\circ$ is integrable over $Z$ with the weight $r$, and $\int_Z\mathcal I_\iota^\circ\,r\,dr\,dz\ge0$.
